name: @qgis/rust
description: Bun/Turbo facade for the Cargo workspace as ONE package. All Rust/C++ build, test, lint, format and coverage commands are defined HERE, owned by this package; they run through pixi because the QGIS-linked crates need CONDA_PREFIX activation that exists only in pixi's default environment. The libqca link the QGIS-backed tests need is provided by the repo-management `setup` task at root.

scripts.test: pixi run -e default bash -c 'pixi run setup >/dev/null && QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen cargo test --workspace --no-default-features --test application_info -- --test-threads=1'
scripts.test:full: pixi run -e default bash -c 'pixi run setup >/dev/null && PROJ_DATA=$CONDA_PREFIX/share/proj QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen QGIS_PLUGINPATH=$CONDA_PREFIX/lib/qgis/plugins cargo test --workspace --no-default-features --test application_lifecycle --test vector_layer -- --test-threads=1'
scripts.lint: bunx biome check package.json && pixi run -e default bash -c 'cargo fmt --all --check && find qgis-sys/src qgis-sys/include \( -name "*.cpp" -o -name "*.h" \) -exec clang-format --dry-run --Werror {} + && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings' && pixi run -e default bash -c 'cargo build -p qgis-sys >/dev/null && SRCS=$(find qgis-sys/src -name "*.cpp") && QT_INC=$CONDA_PREFIX/include/qt && [ ! -d "$QT_INC" ] && QT_INC=$CONDA_PREFIX/include/qt6; CXX_OUT=$(find ../target/debug/build/qgis-sys-*/out/cxxbridge -maxdepth 0 2>/dev/null | head -1) && clang-tidy $SRCS --extra-arg=--sysroot=$CONDA_PREFIX/x86_64-conda-linux-gnu/sysroot --extra-arg=-I$(find $CONDA_PREFIX/lib/gcc -name "stddef.h" | head -1 | xargs dirname) -- -std=c++17 -Iqgis-sys -Iqgis-sys/include -I${CXX_OUT}/include -I${CXX_OUT}/crate -I$CONDA_PREFIX/include/qgis -I$QT_INC -I$QT_INC/QtCore -I$QT_INC/QtGui -I$QT_INC/QtWidgets -I$QT_INC/QtXml'
scripts.format: bunx biome format --write package.json && pixi run -e default cargo fmt --all
scripts.format:cpp: pixi run -e default bash -c 'find qgis-sys/src qgis-sys/include \( -name "*.cpp" -o -name "*.h" \) -exec clang-format -i {} +'
scripts.coverage: pixi run -e default bash -c 'if ! cargo llvm-cov --version >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "cargo-llvm-cov is not on PATH. CI installs it next to pixi, outside the environment, because the conda rust toolchain carries no llvm-tools-preview component: cargo install cargo-llvm-cov --locked" >&2; exit 1; fi && pixi run setup >/dev/null && mkdir -p ../target/coverage && QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen PROJ_DATA=$CONDA_PREFIX/share/proj QGIS_PLUGINPATH=$CONDA_PREFIX/lib/qgis/plugins cargo llvm-cov --workspace --exclude qgis-sys --no-default-features --lcov --output-path ../target/coverage/rust-lcov.info -- --test-threads=1'
